q: Can I bring my pet to Holiday Inn Express Nags Head Oceanfront?
p:
Pets are welcome at Holiday Inn Express Nags Head Oceanfront.
Pet policy description. We welcome one pet 75 lbs. max for a 75 USD fee per stay. Pets must be leashed, may not be left unattended, and are prohibited in the pool, fitness center, and breakfast area. Guests are responsible for all pet related damages.
Pet fee per stay: 75 USD
Pet weight limit: 75
1 pets allowed
Pets allowed: Only dogs allowed
n: Holiday Inn Express Nags Head Oceanfront

q: Can I bring my pet to Holiday Inn Express Kitty Hawk – Outer Banks?
p:
Pets are welcome at Holiday Inn Express Kitty Hawk – Outer Banks.
Pet policy description. Certified ADA service animals who are trained to perform a service for someone with a disability are allowed to stay on property with their owner. Emotional support animals are NOT service animals and are not allowed to be at the property.
